name: Flowing Breath [Breath]
body:
You are capable of using your breath weapon without hesitation.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait, character level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You no longer have to wait 1 turn in between uses of your breath weapon.

Normal: You must wait 1 turn in between uses of your breath weapon.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
